state_scale.note: All three states are mapped to 0-1 for a common grid. The papers use different published scales (1-5, 1-9, 1-6); those scales are not copied or treated as interchangeable.

state_set.note: Fatigue and stress as daily states follow Åkerstedt et al. (2014); daily self-efficacy follows Bellhäuser et al. (2023) and the self-efficacy/goal-attainment loop in Wäschle et al. (2014).

nightly_reflection.note: A single evening reconstruction is supported by Kahneman et al. (2004, DRM) and by the evening diary in Bellhäuser et al. (2023).

behavior_state_separation.note: Behavioral indicators are kept separate from states. Loeffler et al. (2019) show that behavioural delay alone cannot identify procrastination and that reasons must be assessed.

self_efficacy_goal_attainment_direction.note: Wäschle et al. (2014) report reciprocal positive relations between self-efficacy and perceived goal achievement. Only the direction is inherited; no coefficient is transferred.

fatigue_stress_daily_states.note: Åkerstedt et al. (2014) measured fatigue daily and stress several times per day across 42 days and found day-level associations. No daily transition coefficient is taken from that paper.

procrastination_definition.note: Procrastination requires voluntary delay/avoidance. External interruption, illness, task difficulty, and plan change are excluded by schema validation.

persistence_autoregression.note: Day-to-day persistence is consistent with the autoregressive / lagged designs in Bellhäuser et al. (2023), Wäschle et al. (2014), and Åkerstedt et al. (2014). The numeric rho is not from them.

grid_min.note: Numerical grid lower bound for the 0-1 state scale.

grid_max.note: Numerical grid upper bound for the 0-1 state scale.

cold_start_mean.note: Transparent neutral population prior at 0.5 on the 0-1 scale. It is not an individualized estimate and is not derived from the papers.

cold_start_sd.note: Transparent cold-start uncertainty (0.25 on the 0-1 scale).

persistence_rho.note: AR(1) persistence value 0.6. The design is literature-consistent, but this exact value is an engineering initialization, not estimated.

process_noise_sd.note: Day-to-day process noise 0.12. It prevents uncertainty collapse and state lock; it is not a published coefficient.

evidence_sharpness.note: Likelihood tilt per unit evidence strength (2.0). It controls how far one explicit statement can move a state.

strength_weights.note: Mapping from weak/moderate/strong evidence to numeric strength (0.35/0.65/1.0).

goal_attainment_weight.note: Weight of the task-log goal-attainment signal on self-efficacy (0.6). The direction is supported by Wäschle et al. (2014); the magnitude is an engineering choice.

uncertainty_floor.note: Posterior SD floor (0.02) to avoid overconfident point states.

uncertainty_ceiling.note: Prior/posterior SD ceiling (0.50) to avoid uncertainty explosion.

late_start_candidate_minutes.note: A start delay of at least 60 minutes is recorded only as a candidate for review; it is never labelled procrastination by itself.

conflict_policy.note: Opposing evidence is combined by symmetric Bayesian likelihood multiplication; conflicts are flagged, not silently discarded.

extraction_failure_policy.note: Fail closed: an invalid LLM extraction contributes no evidence and is recorded as an error; the day still completes with higher uncertainty.

passive_context_enabled.note: V1 never reads passive context. The interface exists only for future wearable/phone data.

personalization_enabled.note: V1 does not learn personalized transition parameters. Prediction errors are stored as future training data, not used for online learning.
